title: Slack More, Predict Better: Proximal Relaxation for Probabilistic Latent Variable Model-based Soft Sensors
summary: Nonlinear Probabilistic Latent Variable Models (NPLVMs) are a cornerstone of soft sensor modeling due to their capacity for uncertainty delineation. However, conventional NPLVMs are trained using amortized variational inference, where neural networks parameterize the variational posterior.
